summary: This clinical trial tested the study drugs ixekizumab and tirzepatide in adults who have plaque psoriasis, which is a skin condition causing red and scaly patches, along with obesity or being overweight. The study included 281 participants and was sponsored by Eli Lilly and Company. It was a Phase 3 study and is currently Completed. The main goal was to see how the treatments affected both skin symptoms and weight reduction.
